name: Tentador Leches
source:
This game is a short one-scene encounter with your new milkman with various ways to go about approaching him. There are a total of four endings, each with an icon on the menu screen to unlock once you've found it.

[From [url=https://karmalarma.itch.io/tentador-leches]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个游戏是与你的新送奶工的一场简短的单场景遭遇，你可以通过多种方式接近他。共有四个结局，每个结局在菜单屏幕上都有一个图标，找到后即可解锁。

[来自[url=https://karmalarma.itch.io/tentador-leches]itch.io[/url]]
